title: The Stolen Temple Relic
description: Cultists took the seed-relic from the temple two nights ago. The blessing must be spoken over it before the first planting, three weeks off, or I have nothing for the farmers. They carried it east.

objectives.description: Find the cultist temple east of Dalhurst

notes: Threat: the spring planting has no blessing without the relic, and the calendar does not wait. Giver motive: the priestess doesn't trust the guard to reach the eastern temple before the planting deadline. Consequence of refusal: Dalhurst plants unblessed this year - not wired mechanically, stated here for a later pass.
